title: Virkelig god app
body: Virkelig god app. Jeg bruger den dagligt ! Vil helt klart anbefale den.  Dog skod man kun får 3 gratis vaner man kan udnytte
author: Calle1234

title: Works well with some annoying defiencies
body:
The app does what it says on the tin and the ability to decorate habits with nice pictures is a nice touch. The availability of a watch app also makes it quite easy to quickly register an action. 

However, in my view, it loses a star for the lack of an ipad version and it loses another star for the missing update to the watch complication that would have allowed it to work with the new series 4 watch faces.

title: A little slow to navigate
body: I would love if it was faster to see the list. The animations makes it kind of slow to see and scroll through. But else it’s nice 👍🏼

title: Min mest brugte app
body: Denne her app er fantastisk. Hvis de lavede appen til Apple uret ville jeg overveje at købe det bare på grund af denne app. Dog er der nogle små ting som de mangler at fikse. F.eks. går det lidt langsomt når man skal bladre gennem vanerne, men den fungere ellers stort set upåklageligt.
